name: Apokatastasis

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Divine Economy which encompasses the totality of time and eternity.

VINIT.justification: The unmanifest state before the creative act or the fall into multiplicity.

TANCH.justification: The final state where God is all in all and the system reaches closure.

AFWD.justification: The outward movement of being from the source into the created order.

AREV.justification: The return or conversion of the soul back toward the source.

CLINK.justification: The sequential cooperation between divine grace and human will.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-identical principle that remains constant throughout the cycle of descent and return.

FSPLIT.justification: The fragmentation of the primordial unity into the duality of good and evil or spirit and matter.

FFUSE.justification: The gathering of all fragmented parts back into the original unity.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative state of union with the divine.

EVALF.justification: The negative state of alienation or corrective purification.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous experience of suffering and hope where judgment and mercy coincide.

IFIX.justification: The permanent record of every soul's journey and its final place in the pleroma.

phase_3.void_description: The abyss of non-being prior to the first word of creation.
phase_3.true_description: The state of beatitude and alignment with the divine will.
phase_3.false_description: The state of rebellion and ontological distance from the source.
phase_3.both_description: The state of the soul in transition where it is both sinner and saint.

steps.domain_action: The silence of the pre-existent source before the beginning of time.
The Logos recognizes itself as the archetype of all possible existence.
The creative word goes forth to establish the heavens and the earth.
The creation of the first man is recorded as a permanent fact of history.
The unity of the human race splits into the divergent paths of choice.
The righteous follow the path of obedience and light.
The soul ascends through the celestial hierarchies toward the pleroma.
The soul cooperates with grace to achieve higher states of being.
The wayward descend into the darkness of self-will and alienation.
The experience of lack triggers a desire to return to the source.
The soul undergoes the fire of purification where pain and love are one.
The divergent paths of the righteous and the purified wayward meet in the center.
The restored humanity recognizes its original image in the Logos.
The temporal journey is linked to the eternal purpose of the creator.
The final state of every creature is inscribed in the eternal memory.
The cycle completes as God becomes all in all within the closed boundary of eternity.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Divine Will which translates eternal ideas into temporal realities.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Prayer and revelation which facilitate communication between the creator and the creature.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The Akasha or the mind of God which preserves the essence of every being.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Providence which governs the timing of every event in the history of salvation.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Holy Scriptures and the sacred tradition which serve as the bootstrap for the soul.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The kenotic self-emptying of the divine and the labor of the creature.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The system is a closed cycle where all lost energy is recovered in the final restoration.
